brief: Small Carpenter Gothic chapel in white board-and-batten: a steep gable-front nave topped by a Celtic cross, with a lower gabled entry vestibule set in front whose pointed-arch door is painted bright red. Tall narrow lancet windows along the sides, a brick chimney on the roof slope, a hanging lantern and a small gabled signboard by the steps. Tucked between old commercial buildings a block off the square in a college town.
